subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core persisted per-agent spend-alert feature, including best-effort at-most-once owner notifications, rather than keeping spend monitoring pull-based or external?
rationale: The implementation adds a new configuration, persistent data model, and notification behavior; correctness work can fix rounding, but maintainers must choose whether this is a supported core product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the feature with precision repair
options.body: Keep the feature in core, require cumulative-cost precision and upgrade coverage, then review redacted live owner-route proof.

options.title: Defer the core feature
options.body: Keep existing pull-based usage reporting and direct the broader proactive-alert design to a future maintainer-sponsored product proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the feature with precision repair
recommendation.body: Keep the feature in core, require cumulative-cost precision and upgrade coverage, then review redacted live owner-route proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor owns the current proposal and can clarify the operational need, while a maintainer must make the final product decision.
